public_rationale: On June 12, 2026, Anthropic announced that it was removing access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all users under a government directive [e1]. This supports the operational suspension described in the passage, but does not establish the broader claim that no industry can thrive under apparently arbitrary government [e1]. A fair factual verdict on that causal claim would require a measure of thriving, an observation period, and a standard for apparent arbitrariness. The whole sentence is therefore not adjudicable.
limitations: The disclosure establishes the suspension of the two named models, not a literal shutdown of every US AI company.
It does not establish the suspension's effect on industry prosperity.
The claim supplies no measurable criterion or period for thriving and no stable factual standard for apparent arbitrariness.
